deadline.value: Postgraduate research applications are open all year round; no fixed PhD deadline is given on the programme page.
deadline.quote: Postgraduate Research applications are open all year round on our website.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants must identify and contact a potential supervisor before applying; the page does not say agreement is required.
supervisor.quote: You must identify a potential supervisor supervisor from the College of Medical, Veterinary & Life Sciences and contact them to discuss your research proposal before you apply.

funding.value: The page asks applicants to have scholarships or funding from home countries or other organisations, but no institutional funding rule is stated.
funding.quote: We are currently seeking enthusiastic students who are either planning to apply for scholarships or have already secured funding from their home countries or other research organisations.

entry_route.value: The usual standard is a 2.1 honours degree; the page states no master's requirement.
entry_route.quote: Our regular standard of admission is usually a 2.1 honours degree

notes: Represents the medical-sciences PhDs; other MVLS biomedical PhD pages are not recorded here.
